findings.issue: P5.10 switched ownerTest to lib/glob.mjs, so a bare directory coverage glob (`src/api`) or `dir/*` no longer owns the subtree in merge; before, merge's own regex made it own it. diffmap and merge now agree, but agents/archmap-explorer.md:64 only says '<globs you actually read>' and gives no rule that a subtree must be written `dir/**`. An explorer that writes a bare directory now gets silent staleness on update: old elements of that area are never classed owned, so they are never removed or replaced. Only the merge.mjs header comment states the rule.
